holderQuote: Numbtongue sat in his room, dozing off with the sun.
Numbtongue sat in his room, dozing off with the sun.
Those were Pyrite’s thoughts.

He stared at his claws and remembered the events of last night. They hit him again. [Goblin Soulbard]. He reached for a forearm and made to pinch himself, then closed his hand. Lyonette, lugging in groceries with Mrsha, opened the door just in time to see Numbtongue make a fist and wallop himself as hard as he could in the face.
It meant that for a minute, Numbtongue could be Pyrite.
Mrsha had helped with that. And she, Erin, and Lyonette, and Bird were the reasons why Numbtongue stayed. Someone had to protect them. Or were they protecting him?
Numbtongue thought for a moment.

And Wailant kicked Numbtongue in the balls. The [Goblin Soulbard] folded up, as his entire head went blank with agony. Wailant stood over him. Numbtongue was a Redfang Warrior, but even Goblins had limits on the pain they could take. He curled up as Wailant guffawed.
Then he went and took a nap while he leveled up.
After a while, Numbtongue finished eating. He felt…bloated. Too much rich food. And Erin’s Supreme Meat…Meat Supreme Sub…hadn’t helped.

By the time Mrsha came with Erin, Numbtongue was just sitting there. Staring up at their faces. The little Gnoll shyly hid at the outskirts of that place. The [Goblin Soulbard] looked up as Erin walked over. Her footsteps were faltering. And she stared at the Goblins as he had.
“…Numbtongue.”
He leaned forwards on one claw, addressing the screen, looking serious. Mrsha patted Numbtongue. The [Goblin Soulbard] nodded.
He reached out and took Shorthilt’s hand. Reiss heard Numbtongue laugh.
Ulvama grinned at him. She had removed her top. Numbtongue stared at her. He…recognized her. No—
“He knows the old secrets! He—Numbtongue—is a [Ghost Shaman]!?”
Rags met the [Goblin Soulbard] for the first time in the [Garden of Sanctuary]. Tears in her eyes. She didn’t wipe them away. She looked at Numbtongue, seeing him now.
Numbtongue embraced the Skill and new level. It was a [Bard]’s duty to remember Crimshaw’s name.
Numbtongue had a huge problem. It was really eating him up.
Numbtongue, the [Goblin Soulbard], stopped playing his guitar
